name: Morse.IsMinimalPath
why: Both: c in Omega(N; p, q) and L(c) <= L(c') for all c' in Omega(N; p, q), with L = integral over [0,1] of ||deriv||. The length formulas are identical and the two path spaces are equal (piecewise smoothness via break set vs subdivision, isPiecewiseSmooth_iff). Equal for all N, c, p, q.
